lines.text: بحضیض نزدیکتر شود حرکت تدویر بخلاف توالی سریعتر و فضل مذکور کمتر شود و کوکب بطی تر نماید
lines.en: As it gets closer to the perigee, the motion of the epicycle contrary to the succession [of signs] becomes faster, and the aforementioned difference becomes less, and the planet appears slower.

lines.text: لما چون حرکت مرکز کوکب هنوز بتوالیست کوکب را مستقیم گویند تا بجائی رسد که حرکت تدویر
lines.en: Since the motion of the center of the planet is still according to the succession [of signs], the planet is called direct, until it reaches a place where the motion of the epicycle

lines.text: بخلاف توالی با حرکت مرکز معدل بتوالی مقاومت کند و کوکب چند گاه چنان نماید که در یکجای
lines.en: contrary to the succession [of signs] resists the motion of the center of the equant according to the succession [of signs], and the planet appears for some time as if it is in one place

lines.text: ساکنست و در اینحال کوکب را مقیم گویند و بعد از ان حرکت تدویر بخلاف توالی زیاده امد بر حرکت
lines.en: stationary, and in this state the planet is called stationary. And after that, the motion of the epicycle contrary to the succession [of signs] exceeds the motion

lines.text: مرکز معدل بتوالی کوکب بمقدار زیادتی بر خلاف توالی متحرک باشد و در اینحال کوکب را راجع گویند
lines.en: of the center of the equant according to the succession [of signs], the planet moves contrary to the succession [of signs] by the amount of the excess, and in this state the planet is called retrograde.

lines.text: و هر چند بحضیض نزدیکتر شود حرکت او در رجعت سریعتر نماید تا کوکب بحضیض مرئی رسد و انجا
lines.en: And the closer it gets to the perigee, its motion in retrogradation appears faster, until the planet reaches the visible perigee, and there

lines.text: غایت سرعت او باشد در رجعت و وسط زمان آن و چون از حضیض بگذرد در رجعت بطوی
lines.en: is its maximum speed in retrogradation and the middle of its time. And when it passes the perigee, in retrogradation it becomes slower

lines.text: پیدا کند و هر چند بر اید بطی تر شود باز بنوعی که گفتیم مقیم گردد و بعد از آن مستقیم و ثار و و در
lines.en: and the higher it goes, it becomes slower, again in the way we said it becomes stationary, and after that direct, and in

lines.text: سیر سریعتر شود تا بذروه رسد که غایت سرعت او است و استقامت و وسط زمان آن و بعد از ان
lines.en: motion it becomes faster until it reaches the apogee, which is its extreme speed and directness and the middle of its time. And after that

lines.text: حالت اوّل عود کند و از انچه گفتیم لازم می اید که کوکب در یکدوره تدویر دو بار مقیم گردد یکی
lines.en: the first state returns. And from what we said, it necessarily follows that the planet in one revolution of the epicycle becomes stationary twice, one

lines.text: بعد از استقامت و پیش از رجعت و انرا مقام اوّل گویند و دیگر بعد از رجعت و قبل از استقامت
lines.en: after directness and before retrogradation, and they call it the first station, and the other after retrogradation and before directness,

lines.text: و انرا مقام ثانی خوانند و قمر را گرچه تدویر است امّا حرکت او در قطعه علیا که بخلاف توالی
lines.en: and they call it the second station. And although the Moon has an epicycle, its motion in the upper segment, which is contrary to the succession [of signs],

lines.text: است اسرع از حرکت وسط او نیست پس رجعت لازم نیاید لیکن در قطعه علیا بطی
lines.en: is not faster than its mean motion, so retrogradation does not occur, but in the upper segment it is slow

lines.text: و در قطعه سفلی سریع نماید و چون حرکت مرکز معدل نسبت بمرکز عالم مختلف است لا محاله
lines.en: and in the lower segment it appears fast. And since the motion of the center of the equant relative to the center of the universe is variable, inevitably

lines.text: مدّت استقامتی با استقامتی رجوعی با رجوعی متفاوت باشد چه هر گاه حرکت مرکز معدل سریع با
lines.en: the duration of one directness with another directness, [and] one retrogradation with another retrogradation, will be different. Because whenever the motion of the center of the equant is fast,

lines.text: تکافی حرکتین در اواخر استقامت و سریع دهد و در اواخر رجعت زودتر و هر گاه بطی با
lines.en: the equality of the two motions in the late stages of directness occurs quickly, and in the late stages of retrogradation sooner. And whenever it is slow

lines.text: در اواخر استقامت زودتر دست دهد و در اواخر رجعت دیرتر پس زمان استقامت
lines.en: in the late stages of directness it occurs sooner, and in the late stages of retrogradation later. So the time of directness

lines.text: در گاه اوّل بیشتر باشد و در گاه ثانی کمتر و زمان رجعت بعکس و اعظم زمان استقامت
lines.en: in the first case is more, and in the second case less, and the time of retrogradation is the opposite. And the greatest time of directness

summary.headline: Direct and Retrograde Planetary Motion
summary.text: Explanation of planetary direct, stationary, and retrograde motion through the epicycle, equant, perigee, and apogee. The Moon is distinguished as never retrograding, while varying equant motion produces unequal durations; Zij tables give Saturn’s maximum direct motion as eight months and four days and Jupiter’s as nine months and …
